T43 final acceptance — 2026-11-03

Accepted final distribution 8282cbcade3be32b437f7391be7e216d9a6b1074, reviewed seed 601e4694f9726b2228d3571efdb5cfc061c6d442. All 20 criteria are verified within their source-only scope. Exact criterion map and retained evidence are published at coordinator 8f514c72fc979ef5d6c47fae459d1e47ab98e576 under docs/qa-logs/2026-11-02-m6-resume/t43-final/; final errata are appended to patches-unshipped.md.

Root independently reproduced T5's five immutable comparison outputs byte-equal. The 2,923 frozen D artifacts and 469 selected source/recipe/selector identities are unchanged. The exact 93-key matrix preserves 224 consumers: 188 open and 36 qualified positive results. Seven S1 refusals, scoped cleanup controls, plan-before-mutation, actual final publication and exact-final scan bindings reconcile without producer replay.

New disposable integration against exact coordinator 749e5c7f2df2c8444b07f8521493d12b7f7a962b passes: 26 continuation commands, both resolution lints, rules/register/index/ceremony/hooks, full merged-tree forbidden scan (0 hits / 137,217 files), issue checks and whitespace. Protected source/plan bytes are unchanged. Both logs retain their complete original entries and each branch's order. The original parser refusal and faulty conflict fixture remain recorded failures; the corrected body-conflict fixture and six refusal controls pass. No actual area/next merge occurred.

PL-001 is Resolved for outcome custody only. All 93 source-input gaps remain open (87 wholly open, six mixed). H records 881 retired, eight retained, zero partial; four empty prefixes used nonrecursive rmdir. Cache preservation remains metadata-only; PID 2389 visibility remains unknown and no global no-reference claim is made. No further cleanup is authorized here. High #1408 and Medium #1410 remain open/unfixed with their existing owners; drafts remain unsent.

Four early F controls bind old guard 45612b79; current guard is b7ee4e57. Root retained a separately labelled exact hash reconstruction of the old bytes, not a recovered historical file. Old controls are not relabeled as current-code tests; later receipts bind current code. No literal predicate is waived and no source application, test, generator or cleanup was replayed.

Root will tick #690's 20 criteria and close audit #1412 completed. #690 remains open until actual ordered area integration; reviewed-at/fixed-at stay seed/final8282.

T1 wN:p4 is explicitly dispatched, in the same assigned m6-patches-unshipped-690 tree/branch, to the normal records-only completion step after verifying the closed-completed #1412 readback: existing schema-1 audit-completion.json, exact tracker-final-readback.json/tracker-completion.json, real evidence hashes, retained full acceptance/comment and current source-issue state, pointer and actual dated worklog/INDEX. Use the existing validator, both resolution lints and current record/ceremony/issue checks, normal commit/push hooks, and actual remote/clean receipts. Preserve all accepted source/program/A–H bytes and headers; no merge, producer/control replay, root retirement or runtime. CPUs 8–23. Publish one clean completion tip and checkpoint, then stop. Root verifies the marker; ordered integration and slice closure remain root-owned.
